user.title: Connect to CardDAV
user.description: Birthdays are read from your contacts and shown as one calendar. For iCloud use https://contacts.icloud.com, your Apple Account email and an app-specific password.

data_description.url: The server root or a direct addressbook URL. Addressbooks are discovered automatically.

addressbooks.title: Choose addressbooks
addressbooks.description: Several addressbooks were found. Birthdays from the selected ones go into the calendar.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} no longer work. Enter a new password (for iCloud: a new app-specific password).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server
error.no_addressbooks: No addressbooks found on this server
